walkthroughs.body_html: Global merchandise exports reached $24 trillion in 2022 (WTO). China leads with $3.6 trillion; USA second. South-South trade now exceeds North-South. Just-in-time supply chains link iPhone components from 43 countries.

WTO replaced GATT in 1995; Most Favoured Nation principle prevents discrimination. Doha Round stalled over agricultural subsidies. Disputes include EU vs USA over Boeing-Airbus subsidies, resolved 2021 after 17 years.

IMF Structural Adjustment Programmes required cuts to public spending, privatisation, devaluation. Critics (Stiglitz) argue these worsened poverty. HIPC initiative since 1996 cancelled $76 billion of debt for low-income countries.

mcqs.q: Why can a cold winter NOT disprove climate change?
options: Climate is the long-term statistical average; a single cold winter is a weather event. Climate change is the trend in averages and extremes over decades, not the absence of cold days.
Climate change only happens in summer.
A really cold winter proves global warming is not happening.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a megacity and a world city?
options: Climate change only happens in summer.
Megacities and world cities are the same thing.
A megacity is defined by population (over 10 million); a world city is defined by global economic and cultural influence (e.g. New York, London) — so a city can be one without the other.
